description: This file implements a client for interacting with a documentation-related RPC service, managing process execution, communication, and handling JSON-encoded messages.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: A client that manages a subprocess for documentation-based interactions, handling communication and lifecycle management.

classes.name: piEvent
classes.description: Represents an event message received from the subprocess.

classes.name: agentEndPayload
classes.description: Payload structure for agent end messages, containing message history.

classes.name: rpcResponse
classes.description: Representation of a response from the RPC server.

classes.name: agentMessage
classes.description: A message exchanged with the agent, could be user or assistant messages.

classes.name: contentBlock
classes.description: A block of content, often used within a message for structured text.

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new docsPiClient subprocess with specified options.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the subprocess and waits for a response.

methods.name: Stderr
methods.description: Returns the standard error output captured from the subprocess.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the subprocess, ensuring cleanup.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Reads and buffers stderr output from the subprocess.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads and processes stdout stream, dispatching events accordingly.

methods.name: extractTranslationResult
methods.description: Extracts a translation or response text from the agent's end payload.

methods.name: extractContentText
methods.description: Extracts text from JSON content, which may be either a string or array of blocks.

methods.name: decodeRpcResponse
methods.description: Decodes a JSON message into an rpcResponse structure.

methods.name: getDocsPiAgentDir
methods.description: Determines the directory for agent-related files, creating it if necessary.
